title: parseTrackerAttachmentWord
responsibility: Reads the command-line form owner/repo#PR:path[@commit] that names an attached GitHub file.

inputs.name: parseTrackerAttachmentWord.word
inputs.description: The text given to --spec or --doc; surrounding space is ignored.

outputs.name: parseTrackerAttachmentWord
outputs.description: Repository, path and any pull request or commit; null when malformed, lacking both PR and commit, or leaving the repository.
